subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The group wanted to start over, but there were no extra vegetables.”?
options: The class suggested adding shade sails near the basketball court and planting trees along the fence.
Their teacher suggested adding more water and potatoes.
Their teacher explained that ocean water can carry things for a long distance.
Then a student suggested adding a tag inside each raincoat: "Please bring me home tomorrow.
